discussion.body: Brann Dur. Main-side. Constium shop floor. Hammer, gauges, a coat that was never court clothes. Joins Act 2 after he cuts a pressure line the party was told was safe. Death crises: that line (Act 2) if ignored; Act 7 barrel climb if he stays on the latch too long. Default lives. Contingency: gauging book item explains Cannon aim and the spike recipe. Vortan still has a face even if Brann is gone; the party just has less warning.
